prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production website hero artwork for a software developer profile
Primary request: Create an original cinematic visualization of a black-hole accretion disk as premium contemporary digital art, designed to anchor a recruiter-facing personal site.
Scene/backdrop: deep near-black space with restrained dust and faint orbital geometry.
Subject: one large luminous warped accretion ring and dark event horizon; blue-white light on the approaching side, ember orange and red on the receding side, with a thin photon-gold arc.
Style/medium: high-end 3D product visualization blended with scientific visualization; crisp, sophisticated, dimensional, not a stock NASA image.
Composition/framing: wide landscape composition; place the event horizon and brightest ring in the right 60 percent; keep the left 35 percent darker and lower-detail for overlaid name, role, and contact actions; preserve a strong silhouette at mobile crop sizes.
Lighting/mood: dramatic controlled glow, rich blacks, fine specular energy, confident and modern.
Color palette: void black, shadow navy, blue-white, ember red-orange, photon gold.
Materials/textures: light trails, fine particulate dust, subtle film grain, precise hairline orbit traces.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark, no astronaut, no spacecraft, no UI screenshot, no maritime imagery.
Avoid: generic cyberpunk neon, purple vaporwave, retro 1980s or 1990s computer styling, lens-flare clutter, excessive empty space, decorative blue boxes.
